long_description: Hedgehog is a crypto robo-adviser that manages your funds in broad baskets of digital assets covering up to 85% of crypto's market cap. We already have 15k users monitoring $176m in crypto assets and over $548k in GTV on our V1 product, we have completed our exit interview with the SEC as of 4/24, and our custodial product is now live in the App Store and Google Play.
